set.body:
Turn a loaded BidsProject into a pure StudyCatalog of FirstLevelUnit descriptors without reading voxel payloads eagerly.

Scope:
- Resolve subject, session, task, acquisition, run, echo, space, resolution, and derivative pipeline identities deterministically.
- Join BOLD images, JSON metadata, events, confounds, masks, and optional participants or covariate tables with typed missing or ambiguity errors.
- Validate TR, volume counts, affine and spatial geometry, run ordering, mask policy, and sample identity from metadata and headers.
- Define persistent data references and a composite multi-run ResponseBlockSource in dataset; JVM adapters perform positional reads for uncompressed NIfTI and explicit stage/cache handling for compressed NIfTI.
- Keep filesystem walking and NIfTI IO on the JVM boundary while the catalog and source contracts remain portable.

Acceptance:
- A multi-subject and multi-run fMRIPrep-like fixture compiles to stable units and reports all structural preflight failures without loading whole images.
- Block reads preserve exact run, time, and voxel ordering and allocate in proportion to the requested block.
- Compressed staging is content- or metadata-keyed, reusable, and failure-safe.
- Shared tests pass on JVM and Scala.js; JVM fixture and NIfTI tests pass separately.
set.title: Workflow ingest: compile fMRIPrep BIDS projects into lazy analysis units
